requirements.title: Verified publisher identity
requirements.evidence: 8x8 ID, organization record and accountable maintainer

requirements.title: Source and provenance
requirements.evidence: repository, immutable revision, license and modification notices

requirements.title: Security review
requirements.evidence: threat model, dependency scan, secret scan and resolved critical findings

requirements.title: Capability manifest
requirements.evidence: explicit filesystem, network, device, identity and financial permissions

requirements.title: Isolation and rollback
requirements.evidence: sandbox profile, resource ceilings, kill switch and tested uninstall

requirements.title: Quality and accessibility
requirements.evidence: functional tests, supported devices, keyboard, screen reader and reduced motion

requirements.title: Governance readiness
requirements.evidence: proposal digest, review window, conflict disclosures and voting policy

requirements.title: Commerce readiness
requirements.evidence: pricing, refunds, tax, payout identity and marketplace policy
